turns.text: Hello. I want to return order SC-5216. The email is thymele.jderescu@example.com.

Thank you for verifying your order, Thymele. I can't file a return for SC-5216 yet. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and this order is still marked as shipped, not delivered. Once it arrives, you can contact us again within 14 days of delivery and we'll check the return. Please note that you pay the return postage, and staff must approve any refund. I also made a mistake: I passed this chat to a colleague with an incomplete note, although you hadn't asked for a person. They will read this conversation and can help you further if needed.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.
